## Professional Overview
Tarek Al Ahmadieh is a software engineer specializing in security, post-quantum cryptography, machine learning, and full-stack systems. He contributes actively to prominent open-source projects (liboqs, pandas, TraceRoot) and builds production web applications, privacy-preserving search protocols, and medical deep learning solutions.

## Experience & Open-Source Contributions
- **Open-Source Contributor (liboqs, pandas, TraceRoot, OpenSSL)**:
  - liboqs (Open Quantum Safe): Reported unsafe uint8_t* -> uint64_t* casts in HQC code (#2684), resolved upstream in HQC v5.1.0 update (PR #2692). Proposed fuzzing KEM encapsulation with mutated public keys (#2687); authored draft PR #2710 (harness covering all 41 KEMs: 186,000+ executions, 0 findings under OQS_STRICT_WARNINGS).
  - pandas: Bisected a Windows rank discrepancy (#61896) to a PyArrow bug fixed in 22.0.0; confirmed #59567 persists on 3.1.1 and main.
  - TraceRoot: Reported Slack alert value/threshold bug (#3090) with prepared fix and regression test.
- **MednMind (Jul 2026 – Oct 2026)**: Full Stack Developer — financial settlement features (commissions, running balances), cash-flow reporting, patient workflows, diagnosis autocomplete, RBAC access control, WhatsApp usage tracking.
- **TogetherforChehim (Jun 2026 – Sep 2026)**: Machine & Deep Learning Project — binary & 4-class diabetic neuropathy classification from plantar pressure data (CatBoost, XGBoost, custom CNN, ResNet-18, SHAP, Grad-CAM).
- **MednMind (Apr 2026 – Jul 2026)**: Full Stack Web Development Intern — admin dashboard and revenue/staff/insurance report APIs.

## Key Projects
- **ASAC — Privacy-Preserving Onion-Service Search**: Built in Rust on Tor/Arti onion services using Private Information Retrieval (PIR) to keep queries hidden from honest-but-curious servers.
- **BraTS 2021 Brain Tumor Segmentation**: PyTorch/MONAI 3D U-Net baseline, 5 epochs on 1,251 training cases: 80.5 / 62.9 / 66.2 Dice (WT / TC / ET) on 25% holdout.
- **Kaggle Playground S6E9 — Top 4.7%**: Ranked 167 of 3,575 predicting EV purchase adoption using leak-free target encoding and LightGBM/CatBoost/XGBoost ensemble.
- **HTTP Server & QR Code Generator in C**: Linux TCP socket HTTP server and CLI PNG QR code encoder in pure C.
